Usage: omaplan [--db <path>] [--lang da|en] <command> [options] [--json]
       omaplan --version | --help

Commands:
  open                  Open the window (default without arguments)
  new --title T [--notes N] [--project P] [--priority 1-3] [--start D] [--duration MIN] [--deadline D]
  list [--from D] [--to D] [--project P] [--status todo|done]
  show <id>
  edit <id> [--title T] [--notes N] [--project P] [--priority N] [--start D] [--duration MIN] [--deadline D] [--status S]
  move <id> <when>
  done <id> | undone <id>
  rm <id>
  undo | redo           undo the newest change, or redo the newest undo
  projects
  summary [--week|--month]
  add <text> [--engine ...] [--yes] [--model M] [--endpoint URL]   AI proposal; --yes stores it
  config list | get <key> | set <key> <value> | unset <key> | path
                        settings in config.toml (engine.default, engine.claude.model, dates.order,
                        projects.<name>, ...); `config list` shows every key
  engines               the AI engines: installed or not, and the model each one uses
  skill install [--force]|uninstall   install/remove the bundled agent skill
  mcp                   MCP server over stdio (claude mcp add omaplan -- omaplan mcp)
  snapshot [path]       write plan.json for the read-only edition (also automatic after every change)
  serve [--port N] [--bind ADDR] [--host NAME,...] [--snapshot PATH]   read-only web page (default 127.0.0.1:8787)

Dates accept ISO (2026-12-01, 2026-12-01 14:30) and English/Danish expressions
("tomorrow", "friday 12", "next monday", optional "at 14:30"; "i morgen", "kl. 14:30").
An empty value clears a field: --project "".

Examples:
  omaplan new --title "Write blog post" --project Blog --start friday
  omaplan list --from today --to "next friday" --json
  omaplan move <id> "tuesday at 14:00"
  omaplan done <id>
  omaplan undo --json
  omaplan config set engine.claude.model sonnet
  omaplan config set projects.Blog blue
  omaplan skill install --force   replace customized skill files
